turns.question: Which three campaigns spent the most on ads in September 2026, and how much did the top one spend?
turns.answer: The three campaigns with the most ad spend over 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 were Search NL always-on (3,870.00 EUR, the top one), Social TR spring (2,100.00 EUR) and Newsletter monthly (300.00 EUR); the names of the second and third campaigns held extra text that I ignored.
